## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting/lint, TypeScript, frontend tests, and Rust checks pass.
- [ ] Packaged app checked when native permissions, persistence, or UI behavior changes.
- [ ] Regression tests cover changed persistence, geometry, focus, or history behavior.
- [ ] Documentation/release notes updated where needed.
- [ ] No private PDFs, projects, credentials, or build outputs included.

Attach screenshots from synthetic documents for visible changes.
